# Ankabasi
> Cultural exchange experiences with the Arhuaco community in Gwimake, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Colombia.

Ankabasi offers ancestral cultural immersion (transport from Aracataca, meals, hammock/bohío lodging, spiritual work with the mamo, walks, and community dialogue). Packages from COP $700,000 (1 day/1 night) and COP $1,300,000 (3 days/2 nights); 1 week on request.
